review.notes: Independent fixing review of the NeronModelsAndSemistableAbelianVarietiesPartII package (README, Suggested.lean, metadata) against its accepted plan, by Claude (session claude-ZcgAKZ), who did not write the package (Codex, codex-hkDwpU, PR #9353) or any of its plan jobs. Checked: upstream form; fidelity (168 packet nodes map one-to-one to 168 README subsections; all 723 API entries present, two renamed to the Lean names; every definition has at least three Checks); own words (8-word shingles against Schroer, Ferrand, Temkin-Tyomkin, LLR and corrigendum, Bombieri-Mumford, Witaszek, Liedtke: titles only); process residue; supplier layers and tiers against current TauCetiRoadmap and the lower packages; duplication against TauCetiRoadmap main and Tau Ceti a91d3aaf; more than fifty locators (Schroer, Ferrand, Temkin-Tyomkin, LLR, Bombieri-Mumford, Witaszek, Liedtke, eleven Stacks tags), all correct except Stacks 04S6 (now 02WW); and the adversarial mathematics pass (table in the report). Classification verified independently: an own Tate algorithm over F2(t) reproduces Schroer's eleven configurations, confirms models 12-14 (I2*+E4+~I2, I3*+E4+~I1, IV*+E4+~I2), and an exhaustive search of the 2^18 normalized tuples gives 2592 survivors in exactly fourteen orbits (13 of size 192, one of 96), so the package's correction of Schroer Theorem 10.4 is right; §6.1, §7.3 (two new Checks), §7.5, Downstream consumers and References now say so. Fixed: the Neron pair is not a bundle (the parent builds its node curve by equation) and parent layers corrected (Neron models L1, component groups L2, semistable Picard L3 3.8-3.9 and L4); trace formula cited to TraceFormula L11-14 of the cohomological point-counting family instead of WeilConjectures L1; SF layers named SF.0-SF.5; Stacks 04D1, 02X4, 0417, 05Z2 (absent from SF.1) and the flat-module patching equivalence (Ferrand 2.2(iv), Stacks 0D2I; wrongly cited to SF.3) are now targets in 1.9 and 1.3; flat base change cited to JacobianChallenge A-D; Zariski refinement (Stacks 0C5X) proved in 2.5 and Kodaira classification planned in full; Weierstrass presentation from AlgebraicCurves L10/L12; isogeny invariance of counts derived in 3.8; duplication boundaries for Tau Ceti singular-cubic traces, nodePolynomial and Mathlib Polynomial.reflect; conductor API names unified as AffinePinching.*; duplicate Checks blocks merged; irrelevant 2.14 Check replaced; 5.10 rewritten; 45 Name-the-construction lines, about 70 packet-node slugs and other residue removed; repeated hypothesis sentences inside API lists hoisted or removed in 45 subsections (no item, Check, hypothesis or locator removed; README 841 KB to 679 KB). Suggested.lean: removed the tautology trace_eq_of_count_eq, added reverseWeight_eq_reflect and a negative-control example. lean-check before: exit 0, 68 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry'; after: exit 0, 69 warnings, all 'declaration uses sorry'. intake check-files: 0 problems.
